Specials Gift Cards Financing Cherry CareCredit Affirm Klarna Contact Book Online Our Owners Laura and Charlie Laura Morgan, the esteemed owner of Pellé Medical Spa, has a proven track record of managing successful businesses over the past 18 years. Educated at the University of Nebraska, Laura began her career as the owner and general manager of Morgan Storage in MA. She, alongside her venerable husband Charlie, continued on to found and operate several other commercial real estate development companies and self-storage facilities, and finally became a partner in Pellé Medical Spa in 2013. Laura is an incredible leader who understands the challenges of how to build a thriving business. Additionally, she is involved with several volunteer initiatives in the community. These include her role as the Vice President of Vision International Missions, where she annually travels to underdeveloped countries, and her roles as a crisis counselor for the CareNet Pregnancy Center and nursery care volunteer for the Manchester Vineyard Church. Combining her extensive management history and her well-rounded and compassionate lifestyle, Laura has helped to bring a great energy to Pellé.
